entry.name: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty
entry.note: Retired by AWS. The last day to take the exam was March 31, 2026; AWS states that holders keep an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned. AWS now points candidates to the Machine Learning Engineer Associate
entry.renewal: Retired; existing holders active 3 years from date earned

reading.cost: 300 USD. Visit Exam pricing for additional cost information, including foreign exchange rates.
covers: Architecting ML and deep learning workloads
reading.format: 65 questions, either multiple choice or multiple response. Delivered at a Pearson VUE testing center or as an online proctored exam. Offered in English, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese.
reading.status: This certification is being retired. The last day to take this exam is March 31, 2026. The exam prep resources are available until March 31, 2026. Certification holders will still have an active certification for 3 years from the date it was earned.
reading.summary: AWS Certified Machine Learning - Specialty is a certification that validates expertise in building and deploying machine learning solutions in the AWS Cloud. It demonstrates the ability to architect ML and deep learning workloads, optimize model training, and implement production-ready ML systems following AWS best practices. The exam validates the ability to design, build, deploy, optimize, train, tune, and maintain ML solutions for business problems using the AWS Cloud.
reading.audience: The ideal candidate should have 2 or more years of experience developing, architecting, and running ML or deep learning workloads in the AWS Cloud. It is intended for individuals in an artificial intelligence and ML development or data science role.
reading.validity: This certification is valid for 3 years. Before your certification expires, you can recertify by passing the latest version of this exam. You can still recertify by retaking the exam on or before March 31, 2026. Once recertified, your certification will remain active for 3 years from the date it was earned.
reading.prerequisites: No specific certifications are required prior to preparing for this certification. Candidates commonly earn the AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate, and/or AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate before attempting this exam. Candidates would benefit from first earning an AWS Associate and/or Professional Certification prior to earning a Specialty certification.
